benefits.heading: Why Partner With Us
benefits.description: Strong partnerships are built on mutual value. Here is what each side brings to the table.

forPartners.heading: What you gain
items: Reach an engaged, global audience of motivated learners
Showcase your expertise through co-branded, hands-on content
Strengthen your reputation as a contributor to accessible education
Connect with curious, well-prepared talent early

forUs.heading: What we gain
items: Expert content grounded in real-world practice
Tools, datasets, and infrastructure we could not build alone
Support that keeps our resources free and open to everyone
Fresh perspectives that keep our curriculum current

process.heading: How Partnership Works
process.description: A simple, low-commitment path from first contact to launch. We start small and grow what works.

steps.title: Reach out
steps.description: Send the form below or email us. Tell us who you are and the kind of collaboration you have in mind.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.description: We reply within a few business days and schedule a 30-minute call to explore goals, audiences, and fit.

steps.title: Pilot collaboration
steps.description: We define a small first project — one lesson, one tool, or one workshop — and ship it together.

steps.title: Formalize & grow
steps.description: If the pilot works for both sides, we formalize the partnership and plan what comes next.

form.heading: Become a Partner
form.description: Tell us a little about your organization and what you would like to build together. We reply to every serious inquiry.
form.name: Full Name *
form.messagePlaceholder: What would you like to build together? Goals, timelines, anything helpful...
form.privacyNote: Your message is sent to Formspree, a third-party delivery service, and is used only to reply to you. Please do not include sensitive information.

success.title: Thank You!
success.message: Your partnership inquiry has been sent. We’ll be in touch within a few business days.

items.question: Does partnering cost anything?
items.answer: No. Content and workshop partnerships are free for both sides — we co-create and cross-promote. Sponsored partnerships are optional and discussed case by case.

items.question: Can for-profit companies partner with a non-profit initiative?
items.answer: Yes. Nuniversity is a non-profit educational initiative, and we welcome companies that want to share knowledge, tools, or training while keeping education open.

items.question: What do you expect from partners?
items.answer: Accuracy, respect for our open-education mission, and genuine collaboration. Partners keep editorial honesty — no pay-for-placement content.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A small pilot — like a guest lesson or a single tool — typically ships within a few weeks of the first call.
